detail.longDescription: Can't start? Promise yourself two minutes, and make the first step physical: open the document, type the title. Our app Now starts every task with a calm two-minute ring and one concrete first step. Stopping early still counts. Free core, no account. Not medical treatment. https:// apps.apple.com/us/app/now-adhd -task-starter/id6794488304 # productivity # procrastination # AIassisted
